build_moses_tokenizer: build a MosesTokenizer instance with source and target language args for NLP tokenization
encode_text_with_moses: encode a string into tokenized text using the MosesTokenizer encode method
decode_text_with_moses: decode a tokenized string back into natural text using the MosesTokenizer decode method
configure_moses_tokenizer_args: configure MosesTokenizer argparse arguments for source language, target language, dash splits, and escape options
register_moses_tokenizer: register the MosesTokenizer class with the fairseq tokenizer registry under the name moses
